# Pineapple

> Pineapple is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) C# library from MILL5 with Guava-inspired core utilities for .NET 8 and .NET 10. Install with `dotnet add package Pineapple`. SQL Server / EF Core helpers ship separately as `Pineapple.Data`. Built by Microsoft MVP Richard Crane at MILL5.

Key facts:
- NuGet: Pineapple, Pineapple.Data — synchronized version {{ site.version }}, released together
- Targets: net8.0, net10.0 (previous releases: Pineapple 1.0.41 targets netstandard2.0; Pineapple.Data 1.0.1 targets netcoreapp3.1)
- Namespaces: Pineapple.Common, Pineapple.Data, Pineapple.Threading, Pineapple.Diagnostics, Pineapple.Health, Pineapple.Networking, Pineapple.Extensions
- Source: https://github.com/MILL5/pineapple
- Website: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}
- License: Apache 2.0 (free, open source)
- NuGet downloads: 110K+ (Pineapple)
- Author: Richard Crane (Microsoft MVP, Founder of MILL5) — https://mvp.microsoft.com/en-US/MVP/profile/10ce0bc0-7536-43f6-b28c-e9601a4a0d0d
- Publisher: MILL5, LLC — https://mill5.com (Boston-based Microsoft Gold Partner)
- Podcast: Inventing Fire with AI — https://inventingfirewith.ai
- Support: rich@mill5.com

## Docs

- [Getting started]({{ '/getting-started/' | absolute_url }}): install and first use
- [Guard clauses (Preconditions)]({{ '/guides/preconditions/' | absolute_url }}): CheckIsNotNull, CheckIsNotNullOrWhitespace, CheckIsNotLessThan, CheckIsValidDateRange, CheckIsWellFormedUri, CheckIsCondition
- [ShortGuid]({{ '/guides/shortguid/' | absolute_url }}): 22-char URL-safe Guid encoding; SQL Server GUID ordering (OrderByGuid, SqlCompareTo)
- [HashCode]({{ '/guides/hashcode/' | absolute_url }}): deterministic xxHash32 hash combining, stable across processes
- [RowVersion]({{ '/guides/rowversion/' | absolute_url }}): SQL Server rowversion as a comparable struct
- [Migration]({{ '/guides/migration/' | absolute_url }}): built-in replacements for APIs deprecated in 2.0 (PINE001–PINE008)
- [Rate limiting]({{ '/guides/rate-limiting/' | absolute_url }}) (deprecated, PINE002): use System.Threading.RateLimiting
- [Timeouts and backoff]({{ '/guides/timeouts-and-backoff/' | absolute_url }}): Parallelism; AccurateTimeout, SimpleTimeout, ExponentialWait are deprecated (PINE003)
- [Diagnostics]({{ '/guides/diagnostics/' | absolute_url }}): TimingScope (structured ILogger), ConsoleColorScope; MeasureScope and CallsPerMinute are deprecated (PINE004)
- [Cleanup and async]({{ '/guides/cleanup-and-async/' | absolute_url }}): Cleanup.SafeMethod, SynchronizationContextScope, ImmutableExtensions
- [Health and networking]({{ '/guides/health-and-networking/' | absolute_url }}) (deprecated, PINE001/PINE006): use HealthChecks and AutomaticDecompression
- [Pineapple.Data]({{ '/guides/data/' | absolute_url }}): InformationSchemaContext (EF Core), SqlClient.Check
